parsed.why: Protective state: anti-discrimination covering accommodations, hate-crime enhancements, open markers, care protection; national border/visa document exposure still applies.
Hostile: mob attack with victims charged, men's jail/male search despite female ID, no GI protections, surgery-only markers, highest trans-killing rate; national border adds.
Very restrictive: K-12 and state-facility bans, marker changes blocked, adult care funding ban, no GI discrimination/hate-crime protection; less documented visitor violence than slot 2.
Strong protections: broad anti-discrimination, chosen-name law, facilities access, hate crime, court-ordered care resumption; pending ballot measures and national funding pressure.
Restrictive laws enacted but courts repeatedly enjoin them under state constitution; facilities and care bans blocked, marker changes in litigation; thin statutory protections remain.
